title: Role-Scoped Inbox
description: A dispatcher advancing someone else's shipment shouldn't accidentally light up their own notification bell for it — every notification belongs to exactly one user, and the dropdown should only ever show that user's own.
successCondition: With two distinct customer accounts, each having triggered at least one notifying event (e.g. each booking their own shipment), logging in as customer A shows only customer A's notifications in the dropdown (customer B's notification title/body never appears), and logging in as customer B shows the mirror image — checked by content, not just count, since two customers could coincidentally have the same unread count.
hints: GET /api/notifications is scoped to the calling user server-side — this challenge is confirming the UI doesn't accidentally leak or mix state across an account switch (e.g. stale state left over from a previous session in the same browser tab).
Log out fully between checking the two accounts so no cached notification state from customer A survives into customer B's session.
